title: Computational checks for Complete probability logics for neutrosophic triples
description: Reproducibility package for Complete probability logics for neutrosophic triples: a response to Rivieccio's completeness question. Eleven finite and randomized sanity checks cover probability translations, normalized and lifted validities, LP/FDE/K3 consequence, satisfiability reductions, indeterminacy-sensitive consequence and signed-charge representations. Includes original scripts, archived reference outputs, a runner and an explicit verifier. Computations do not replace the formal proofs. Creator order follows the associated article and does not assert original programmer attribution. Supplement-specific CC BY 4.0 notice and original parent-project MIT notice are preserved and documented.
